The Program

More Than a Promo Code.

Whether you are a creator, coach, fitness professional, wellness educator or community builder, we provide the tools to introduce your audience to Atlas while rewarding the business you generate.

 

You receive your own referral link and promotional code, access to performance tracking and monthly commission payments on qualifying orders.

The Process

Four Steps. That's It.

01

Apply

Complete the short application and tell us about yourself, your audience and how you plan to promote Atlas.

02

Get Approved

Approved partners receive their personal affiliate link, discount code and access to their affiliate dashboard.

03

Introduce Atlas through your approved channels using your personal referral link or promotional code. Your attributable orders are tracked through the Atlas affiliate system.

04

Earn

Earn commission on qualifying referred sales. Approved commissions are paid monthly once the minimum payment threshold has been reached.

Partner FAQ

Questions? We've Got You.

How much commission do Atlas partners earn?

Approved Atlas Partners start at 15% commission on qualifying attributed sales. Higher commission levels may be available to qualifying high-performing partners.

What discount does my audience receive?

Your personal affiliate code can provide eligible new customers with an exclusive Atlas discount. Current discount levels and eligible products will be displayed inside your partner account.

How are my sales tracked?

Approved partners receive a unique referral link and promotional code. Eligible purchases attributed through these methods are recorded within the Atlas affiliate system.

What happens if someone doesn't use my link but uses my code?

Where supported by the affiliate system, purchases using your valid personal promotional code will be attributed to your account even if the customer did not originally access Atlas through your referral link.

How often are commissions paid?

Approved commissions are paid monthly once your account reaches the minimum payout threshold.

What is the minimum payout?

Recommended minimum payout:

500,000 IDR

Balances below the threshold automatically carry forward to the next payment period.

How are payouts made?

Available payment options may include:

* Indonesian bank transfer

* Wise

* Cryptocurrency / USDT

Available payout methods may vary by country.

Do I need a large following?

No.

We look at audience relevance, engagement, content quality and trust — not follower count alone.

Can gyms or businesses apply?

Yes.

Gyms, coaches, wellness businesses, communities and relevant organisations can apply.

For larger commercial arrangements, contact Atlas regarding a custom partnership.

Can I run paid advertisements using my affiliate link?

Only with prior written approval from Atlas Longevity.

Partners may not bid on Atlas Longevity trademarks, company names or branded search terms without permission.

Can I promote Atlas using health or medical claims?

No.

Partners must only use claims and marketing materials approved by Atlas Longevity.

Atlas products are marketed for lawful research use only and must not be represented as approved medicines or promoted as diagnosing, treating, curing or preventing disease.

What happens when an order is cancelled or refunded?

Cancelled, fraudulent, chargeback or refunded transactions do not qualify for commission.

If commission was previously recorded, it may be reversed before payment.

Can I buy through my own affiliate link?

Self-referrals do not qualify unless specifically authorised by Atlas Longevity.

Can Atlas close an affiliate account?

Atlas reserves the right to suspend or terminate participation for violations of affiliate terms, misleading advertising, prohibited claims, fraudulent activity or behaviour that may damage the Atlas brand.

Looking for Customer Rewards Instead?

Our Affiliate Programme is for approved promotional partners. If you’re an Atlas Longevity customer looking for loyalty stamps, store credit or refer-a-friend rewards, visit Atlas Rewards.
